senses.en: a vertical arrangement of items or a printed page section
a regular newspaper or magazine feature on a particular subject
a tall upright structure, often supporting a roof

ex.en: Our professor circled a newspaper column on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了报纸专栏。

ex.en: A campus survey used a newspaper column to explain a pattern in public communication.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用报纸专栏来解释公共传播中的一种模式。

col: a column of figures｜一列数字
tip: column 是竖列，row 是横行；词尾 n 不发音。

senses.en: to encourage something to develop or become more widely accepted
to give someone a higher position at work
to attract attention to something to increase interest or sales

ex.en: I heard the lecturer promote economic growth during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时促进经济增长。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to promote economic growth.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得促进经济增长。

col: promote economic growth｜促进经济增长
be promoted to manager｜获晋升为经理
tip: 晋升到某职位用be promoted to＋职位。

senses.en: A large group of musicians playing different instruments together.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on symphony orchestra.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论交响乐团。

ex.en: In the lecture on the humanities, everyone remembered the example of symphony orchestra.
ex.zh: 在关于人文学科的讲座里，大家都记得交响乐团这个例子。

col: conduct an orchestra｜指挥管弦乐队
play in an orchestra｜在管弦乐队演奏
tip: 指整个乐队；成员通常演奏弦乐、管乐及打击乐器。

senses.en: Relating to the body rather than the mind.
Existing as something real that can be touched or measured.
Relating to natural forces, matter, and energy.

ex.en: I copied physical activity into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把身体活动抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The reading connects physical activity with a larger point about public health.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把身体活动和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: physical偏身体或物质；physiological指生理的。

senses.en: one thousand million
an extremely large quantity, usually expressed as billions

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about a billion dollars.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于十亿美元的简答题。

ex.en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of a billion dollars.
ex.zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得十亿美元这个例子。

tip: 具体数值后不加s；泛指数十亿用billions of。

senses.en: Related to medicine or the treatment of illness.
An examination to check a person's health.

ex.en: The textbook introduces medical treatment in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了医疗。

ex.en: The author returns to medical treatment when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了医疗。

tip: medical作名词多用于英式英语，指体检，不指医生。

senses.en: someone who prepares written material or manages a publication
someone who selects and arranges recorded images or sound
software used to change digital content

ex.en: Office hours began with chief editor.
ex.zh: 答疑从主编开始。

ex.en: The reading connects chief editor with a larger point about public communication.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把主编和关于公共传播的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: editor of a magazine｜杂志编辑
tip: editor可指编辑人员，也可指编辑软件。

senses.en: The sound or action of laughing

ex.en: I copied burst into laughter into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把突然大笑抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss burst into laughter.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论突然大笑的材料。

col: a burst of laughter｜一阵笑声
tip: laughter不可数；表示“一阵笑声”用a burst of laughter。

senses.en: Pleasure and satisfaction in achievements, qualities, or people you value.
Respect for yourself, sometimes involving an exaggerated sense of importance.
To feel especially pleased about your own qualities or achievements.

ex.en: The textbook introduces a sense of pride in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了自豪感。

ex.en: In the lecture on human behavior, everyone remembered the example of a sense of pride.
ex.zh: 在关于人类行为的讲座里，大家都记得自豪感这个例子。

col: hurt someone's pride｜伤害某人的自尊
pride yourself on｜以自身的……为傲
tip: 动词用pride oneself on；形容词用proud of。

senses.en: An event causing great damage, suffering, or loss.
Something that goes extremely badly or fails completely.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about natural disaster.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于自然灾害的简答题。

ex.en: In the lecture on environmental policy, everyone remembered the example of natural disaster.
ex.zh: 在关于环境政策的讲座里，大家都记得自然灾害这个例子。

tip: 也可夸张形容失败：The party was a disaster。

senses.en: someone who enters a building illegally to steal things

ex.en: I copied burglar alarm into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把防盗警报器抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around burglar alarm.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕防盗警报器展开说明。

col: catch a burglar｜抓住入室盗贼
tip: burglar指入室盗贼；robber通常指使用威胁的劫匪。

senses.en: a plant grown in large quantities for food or other uses
the amount of a plant harvested at one time
to remove outer parts of an image or cut hair short

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a bumper crop.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论大丰收。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a bumper crop.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕大丰收展开说明。

tip: crop既指庄稼也指收成；动词可指裁剪照片。

senses.en: to make someone admire or respect someone or something

senses.zh: 使铭记；使意识到重要性
senses.en: to make someone understand how important something is

ex.en: The assignment is to impress someone with, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先以……给某人留下好印象，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: When the class discussed economic policy, the speaker told us to impress someone with.
ex.zh: 全班讨论经济政策时，讲者让我们以……给某人留下好印象。

col: impress someone with｜以……给某人留下好印象
tip: impressed形容人的感受；impressive形容事物令人赞叹。

senses.en: A shop or hospital department that prepares and supplies medicines.
The study and practice of preparing and supplying medicines.

ex.en: Office hours began with community pharmacy.
ex.zh: 答疑从社区药店开始。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around community pharmacy.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕社区药店展开说明。

tip: 药店可数，药剂学不可数；药剂师是pharmacist。

senses.en: A man who is in charge of a school.

ex.en: The textbook introduces school headmaster in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了学校男校长。

ex.en: The reading connects school headmaster with a larger point about academic research.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把学校男校长和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 指男性；英式headteacher不分性别，美式常用principal。

senses.en: kind and concerned about other people's needs
the work of looking after people who need help

ex.en: Office hours began with a caring attitude.
ex.zh: 答疑从关怀的态度开始。

ex.en: The reading connects a caring attitude with a larger point about social change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把关怀的态度和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: a caring environment｜充满关怀的环境
tip: caring指关心别人；careful指做事小心。

senses.en: Finding a total by adding equal groups together.
An increase in quantity, often through repeated reproduction.

ex.en: Our professor circled rapid multiplication on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了快速繁殖；迅速增加。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around rapid multiplication.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕快速繁殖；迅速增加展开说明。

col: rapid multiplication｜快速繁殖；迅速增加
tip: 乘法用multiplication；乘以可用multiplied by。

senses.en: To find someone or something unpleasant or not enjoyable.
A feeling of not liking someone or something.

ex.en: The lab instructions say to dislike doing something.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求不喜欢做某事。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to dislike doing something.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来不喜欢做某事。

col: dislike doing something｜不喜欢做某事
a strong dislike of｜对……的强烈反感
take a dislike to｜开始讨厌
tip: dislike后接名词或动名词：dislike waiting。

senses.en: To respect someone for their qualities or achievements
To look at something with pleasure because it is attractive

ex.en: The professor asked us to admire the view.
ex.zh: 教授让我们欣赏风景。

ex.en: A lecture on human behavior showed why researchers admire the view before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于人类行为的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要欣赏风景。

col: admire someone for something｜因某事钦佩某人
tip: admire sb for sth：因某事钦佩某人。

senses.en: not mixed with other substances
complete and containing nothing of a different kind
concerned with theory rather than practical uses

ex.en: The textbook introduces pure water in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了纯净水。

ex.en: The author returns to pure water when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了纯净水。

tip: pure既可指无杂质，也可加强语气，如pure luck。

senses.en: Open your mouth widely and breathe deeply from tiredness or boredom.
An involuntary wide opening of the mouth with a deep breath.

ex.en: The assignment is to yawn widely, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先张大嘴打哈欠，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: When the class discussed public health, the speaker told us to yawn widely.
ex.zh: 全班讨论公共卫生时，讲者让我们张大嘴打哈欠。

tip: 打哈欠可说yawn或give a yawn。

senses.en: An exam given about halfway through a course.
Happening in the middle of a term.

ex.en: The midterm covers the first six lectures.
ex.zh: 期中考试涵盖前六次讲座。

ex.en: Students who review a little each week usually find the midterm less rushed.
ex.zh: 每周复习一点的学生，通常不会把期中考试复习得太赶。

tip: 也可写作 mid-term。托福听力里多指考试，不是政治上的中期选举，除非语境如此。

senses.en: Having a natural ability to do something very well.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about highly talented.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于极具天赋的的简答题。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around highly talented.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕极具天赋的展开说明。

col: a talented musician｜有天赋的音乐家
a talented artist｜有才华的艺术家
tip: talented强调天赋；skilled强调熟练技能。

senses.en: unhappy because someone has something you want

senses.zh: 因担心失去爱而吃醋的
senses.en: upset because someone you love shows interest in another person

ex.en: Office hours began with a jealous partner.
ex.zh: 答疑从爱吃醋的伴侣开始。

ex.en: The reading connects a jealous partner with a larger point about human behavior.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把爱吃醋的伴侣和关于人类行为的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: a jealous partner｜爱吃醋的伴侣
tip: 常用be jealous of；既可指嫉妒，也可指吃醋。

senses.en: an edible seed that grows underground inside a thin shell
a very small amount of money, expressed as peanuts

ex.en: Office hours began with peanut butter.
ex.zh: 答疑从花生酱开始。

ex.en: A campus survey used peanut butter to explain a pattern in public health.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用花生酱来解释公共卫生中的一种模式。

col: work for peanuts｜为微薄报酬工作
tip: 表示“极少的钱”时用复数peanuts，属非正式用法。

senses.en: Relating to laws or the system that applies them
Allowed by the law

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on perfectly legal.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论完全合法。

ex.en: A campus survey used perfectly legal to explain a pattern in public institutions.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用完全合法来解释公共制度中的一种模式。

tip: legal可指“法律相关的”，不一定指“合法的”。

senses.en: relaxed and not easily upset or worried

ex.en: The professor explained easy-going with a short example from campus.
ex.zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了随和的。

ex.en: Students who can explain easy-going usually follow the rest of a lecture on human behavior.
ex.zh: 能解释随和的的学生，通常跟得上一节关于人类行为的讲座。

tip: 形容性格随和、不易生气，不表示懒惰。

senses.en: A particular way of doing something, often requiring skill.
The skill someone shows when performing a particular activity.

ex.en: Our professor circled improve your technique on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了提高技艺。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss improve your technique.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论提高技艺的材料。

col: a technique for doing something｜做某事的方法
tip: technique重在具体方法；technology指科技。

senses.en: A remark expressing admiration or approval.
To tell someone that you admire something about them.

ex.en: The textbook introduces a sincere compliment in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了真诚的赞美。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a sincere compliment.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕真诚的赞美展开说明。

col: pay someone a compliment｜称赞某人
compliment someone on something｜称赞某人的某方面
tip: compliment是赞美；complement是补充、相辅相成。

senses.en: The ability or authority to control people, events, or decisions.
Energy used to make machines and equipment work.
To supply energy that makes something work.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on political power.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论政治权力。

ex.en: The reading connects political power with a larger point about social change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把政治权力和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 表示有权做某事用have the power to do。

senses.en: An online audio programme available to stream or download.
To produce and distribute an online audio programme.

ex.en: Our professor circled podcast episode on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了一期播客。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around podcast episode.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕一期播客展开说明。

col: listen to a podcast｜收听播客
host a podcast｜主持播客节目
subscribe to a podcast｜订阅播客
tip: 收听播客用listen to a podcast，别漏掉to。

senses.en: to understand someone's words, actions, or intentions incorrectly

ex.en: The lab instructions say to misunderstand instructions.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求误解指示。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to misunderstand instructions.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来误解指示。

col: misunderstand someone's intentions｜误会某人的意图
tip: 过去式和过去分词均为misunderstood。

senses.en: Related to the simplest or first stages of learning.
Relating to the first years of formal school education.

ex.en: Office hours began with elementary knowledge.
ex.zh: 答疑从基础知识开始。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around elementary knowledge.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕基础知识展开说明。

tip: elementary school主要用于美式英语，英式常用primary school。

senses.en: an act of changing position or moving the body
an organised effort by people seeking shared social change
one main section of a long piece of music

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on freedom of movement.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论行动自由。

ex.en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of freedom of movement.
ex.zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得行动自由这个例子。

tip: 指具体动作或社会运动时可数；泛指移动可不可数。

senses.en: Someone with extensive knowledge or skill in a particular subject.
Having or showing great knowledge or skill.

ex.en: Office hours began with medical expert.
ex.zh: 答疑从医学专家开始。

ex.en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of medical expert.
ex.zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得医学专家这个例子。

col: an expert on｜某方面的专家
tip: expert on/in表示某领域的专家。

senses.en: A special event held to mark a happy occasion.
The act of showing happiness about something special.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on birthday celebration.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论生日庆祝活动。

ex.en: A campus survey used birthday celebration to explain a pattern in social change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用生日庆祝活动来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。

col: hold a celebration｜举办庆祝活动
tip: 指具体庆祝活动时可数；指庆祝行为时不可数。

senses.en: A flat shape with three straight sides and three angles.
A triangular metal musical instrument struck with a small metal stick.

ex.en: The textbook introduces right-angled triangle in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了直角三角形。

ex.en: A campus survey used right-angled triangle to explain a pattern in academic research.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用直角三角形来解释学术研究中的一种模式。

tip: 英式说right-angled triangle，美式常说right triangle。

senses.en: a visual display of information, often showing comparisons or changes
to record or show how something develops over time
a detailed map used for navigation at sea or in air

ex.en: The textbook introduces bar chart in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了条形图。

ex.en: The author returns to bar chart when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了条形图。

tip: 图表用chart；普通地图用map，海图可用chart。

senses.en: A natural ability to do something well.
People who have strong abilities in a particular field.

ex.en: Our professor circled natural talent on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了天生的才能。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around natural talent.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕天生的才能展开说明。

col: a talent for｜在某方面的天赋
tip: 表示某方面的天赋，用a talent for加名词或动名词。

senses.en: Rest or enjoyable activity that reduces stress and tension.
The process of muscles becoming less tight.
The act of making rules or restrictions less strict.

ex.en: I copied muscle relaxation into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把肌肉松弛抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: In the lecture on public health, everyone remembered the example of muscle relaxation.
ex.zh: 在关于公共卫生的讲座里，大家都记得肌肉松弛这个例子。

tip: 表示放松、休息时通常不可数：for relaxation。

senses.en: Attractive and fashionable in appearance or design

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about stylish clothes.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于时髦的衣服的简答题。

ex.en: The reading connects stylish clothes with a larger point about the humanities.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把时髦的衣服和关于人文学科的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: a stylish design｜有格调的设计
a stylish interior｜雅致的室内空间
tip: stylish强调时尚美观；不等于昂贵或奢华。

senses.en: relating to a whole country or its people
a person who is a citizen of a particular country

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about foreign national.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于外国公民的简答题。

ex.en: In the lecture on public institutions, everyone remembered the example of foreign national.
ex.zh: 在关于公共制度的讲座里，大家都记得外国公民这个例子。

tip: national侧重一国整体；international指国际的。

senses.en: A wind instrument held sideways and played by blowing across it.

ex.en: I copied a flute solo into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把长笛独奏抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: In the lecture on the humanities, everyone remembered the example of a flute solo.
ex.zh: 在关于人文学科的讲座里，大家都记得长笛独奏这个例子。

tip: 英式常称演奏者为flautist，美式常用flutist。

senses.en: The ability to form mental pictures or invent new ideas.

ex.en: The textbook introduces vivid imagination in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了丰富的想象力。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around vivid imagination.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕丰富的想象力展开说明。

col: a figment of the imagination｜凭空想象的事物
tip: imaginative指有想象力的；imaginary指想象中的。

senses.en: not kind or welcoming towards others
making an activity difficult or causing harm

ex.en: The textbook introduces environmentally unfriendly in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了对环境不利的。

ex.en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of environmentally unfriendly.
ex.zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得对环境不利的这个例子。

tip: 虽以-ly结尾，但通常是形容词，不是副词。

senses.en: A difficult task or situation that tests someone's abilities.
Question whether something is true, fair, or acceptable.
Invite someone to compete or test their abilities.

ex.en: The professor explained challenge with a short example from campus.
ex.zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了挑战。

ex.en: A reading on academic research uses challenge when the author sets up the main claim.
ex.zh: 一篇关于学术研究的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了挑战。

col: meet a challenge｜成功应对挑战
challenge someone to a contest｜向某人发起比赛挑战
tip: challenge作动词可直接接观点，表示质疑。

senses.en: to transfer files from a device to an online system
the transfer of a file online, or the file itself

ex.en: I heard the lecturer upload a file during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时上传文件。

ex.en: A lecture on technological change showed why researchers upload a file before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于技术变革的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要上传文件。

col: upload to a server｜上传至服务器
tip: 上传用upload，下载用download；上传至某处用to。

senses.en: A small piece of soft paper used for wiping.
A group of similar cells performing a particular bodily function.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about muscle tissue.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于肌肉组织的简答题。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around muscle tissue.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕肌肉组织展开说明。

col: a box of tissues｜一盒纸巾
tip: 纸巾是可数名词；生物组织通常不可数。

senses.en: something said or written to express information or an opinion
a formal public announcement about a particular matter
a record showing financial transactions over a period

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about a bank statement.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于银行对账单的简答题。

ex.en: In the lecture on public communication, everyone remembered the example of a bank statement.
ex.zh: 在关于公共传播的讲座里，大家都记得银行对账单这个例子。

tip: 作“陈述”时是可数名词；银行对账单也用statement。

senses.en: A woman who is getting married or has just married.

ex.en: I copied a beautiful bride into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把美丽的新娘抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: A campus survey used a beautiful bride to explain a pattern in social change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用美丽的新娘来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。

tip: bride指新娘，groom指新郎。

senses.en: unable to understand something or think clearly
unclear or difficult to follow because of poor organisation

ex.en: I copied confused about into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把对……感到困惑抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The reading connects confused about with a larger point about academic research.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把对……感到困惑和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: confused形容人困惑；confusing形容事物令人困惑。

senses.en: The smallest amount or level possible or allowed.
Being the smallest amount or level possible or allowed.

ex.en: The textbook introduces a minimum of in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了至少。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a minimum of.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论至少的材料。

col: keep something to a minimum｜将某事物减至最低程度
tip: a minimum of 后接数量，表示“至少”。

senses.en: a public statement giving people information or news

ex.en: Office hours began with official announcement.
ex.zh: 答疑从官方公告开始。

ex.en: A campus survey used official announcement to explain a pattern in public communication.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用官方公告来解释公共传播中的一种模式。

tip: 表示发布公告时用make an announcement。

senses.en: The upper front part of the body, enclosing heart and lungs.
A large strong box with a lid, used for storage.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a wooden chest.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论木箱。

ex.en: In the lecture on public health, everyone remembered the example of a wooden chest.
ex.zh: 在关于公共卫生的讲座里，大家都记得木箱这个例子。

tip: chest指胸部或大箱子；chest of drawers才是抽屉柜。

senses.en: the state of being protected from danger or harm

ex.en: Our professor circled road safety on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了道路安全。

ex.en: In the lecture on public health, everyone remembered the example of road safety.
ex.zh: 在关于公共卫生的讲座里，大家都记得道路安全这个例子。

col: for safety reasons｜出于安全考虑
tip: 通常不可数；safe是形容词，safety是名词。

senses.en: having a liking or affection for someone or something
showing or expressing warmth and affection

ex.en: The textbook introduces fond memories in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了温馨的回忆。

ex.en: The reading connects fond memories with a larger point about human behavior.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把温馨的回忆和关于人类行为的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: be fond of后接名词或动词-ing，不接to do。

senses.en: A public display of art, objects, or products.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on art exhibition.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论艺术展。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss art exhibition.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论艺术展的材料。

tip: exhibition指整场展览；exhibit可指一件展品。

senses.en: The gas water becomes when heated, often seen as white mist.
To cook food using steam from boiling water.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about steam engine.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于蒸汽机的简答题。

ex.en: A campus survey used steam engine to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用蒸汽机来解释自然科学中的一种模式。

col: run out of steam｜耗尽精力
tip: steam作名词通常不可数；作动词可表示蒸食物。

senses.en: a strong feeling of fear, shock, or disgust
a type of fiction intended to frighten its audience

ex.en: The textbook introduces a sense of horror in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了恐惧感。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a sense of horror.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕恐惧感展开说明。

tip: 情绪义通常不可数；in horror表示惊恐地。

senses.en: a written account of someone's life by another person

ex.en: Our professor circled an authorised biography on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了经本人授权的传记。

ex.en: A campus survey used an authorised biography to explain a pattern in the humanities.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用经本人授权的传记来解释人文学科中的一种模式。

col: a biography of someone｜某人的传记
an authorised biography｜经本人授权的传记
tip: biography是他人为某人写的传记；自传用autobiography。

senses.en: an arrangement accepted by two or more people or groups
the state of sharing an opinion or accepting a proposal
a grammatical match between related words in a sentence

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about subject–verb agreement.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于主谓一致的简答题。

ex.en: The author returns to subject–verb agreement when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了主谓一致。

tip: 具体协议可数；表示意见一致时通常不可数。

senses.en: A system of connected people, things or places.
A group of broadcasting stations sharing programmes.
To meet people and develop useful professional relationships.

ex.en: Office hours began with transport network.
ex.zh: 答疑从交通网络开始。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss transport network.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论交通网络的材料。

col: network with colleagues｜与同行建立联系
tip: network强调多个节点之间相互连接。

senses.en: belief in gods or spiritual powers, with related practices

ex.en: The textbook introduces freedom of religion in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了宗教自由。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around freedom of religion.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕宗教自由展开说明。

tip: 泛指宗教时不可数；指某一种宗教时可数。

senses.en: a short sleep, usually during the day
to sleep briefly, usually during the day

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on an afternoon nap.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论午后小睡。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around an afternoon nap.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕午后小睡展开说明。

col: a power nap｜恢复精力的短睡
tip: 动词变化要双写p：napped、napping。

senses.en: an official document allowing someone to do something
freedom to depart from usual rules or factual accuracy

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on driving licence.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论驾驶执照。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss driving licence.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论驾驶执照的材料。

col: apply for a licence｜申请许可证
tip: 英式名词用licence，动词用license；美式都用license。

senses.en: an official document showing successful completion of a course

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on high school diploma.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论高中文凭。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around high school diploma.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕高中文凭展开说明。

col: diploma in nursing｜护理专业文凭
tip: diploma多指毕业或课程文凭，不等同于degree学位。

senses.en: finding something previously unknown, or the thing that is found

ex.en: I copied scientific discovery into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把科学发现抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around scientific discovery.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕科学发现展开说明。

tip: discovery是发现原已存在的事物，不同于invention。

senses.en: Performances or activities that people enjoy watching or doing.

ex.en: The textbook introduces family entertainment in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了适合全家的娱乐。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around family entertainment.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕适合全家的娱乐展开说明。

col: a form of entertainment｜一种娱乐形式
tip: 通常不可数：提供娱乐用provide entertainment。

senses.en: to think about something you do not know
a feeling of surprise and admiration
something unusually impressive or surprising

ex.en: The lab instructions say to wonder whether.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求想知道是否。

ex.en: The reading asks you to wonder whether and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你想知道是否，然后再核对第二个来源。

tip: wonder后接疑问词从句时，用陈述语序。

senses.en: to take goods or messages to their intended destination
to give a speech, lecture, or presentation
to produce the results or benefits that were promised

ex.en: The professor asked us to deliver a parcel.
ex.zh: 教授让我们递送包裹。

ex.en: The passage says students who can deliver a parcel follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够递送包裹的学生更容易跟上论点。

col: deliver on a promise｜兑现承诺
tip: 递送用deliver sth to sb；兑现承诺可用deliver on。

senses.en: Cheerful and full of enjoyment.

ex.en: Our professor circled merry laughter on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了欢快的笑声。

ex.en: The reading connects merry laughter with a larger point about human behavior.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把欢快的笑声和关于人类行为的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 常形容欢庆气氛；make merry意为欢庆作乐。

senses.en: To give someone facts or tell them about something.
To provide knowledge that shapes a decision, opinion, or approach.

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to inform policy.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何为政策提供依据。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to inform policy.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得为政策提供依据。

col: inform someone of something｜告知某人某事
keep someone informed｜随时告知某人最新情况
tip: 告知某人某事用inform sb of/about sth。

senses.en: a reduction in the usual price
to sell something at a reduced price
to consider something unlikely or less important

ex.en: The professor explained discount with a short example from campus.
ex.zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了折扣。

ex.en: The sample listening brings up discount while discussing evidence about economic policy.
ex.zh: 示例听力在讨论关于经济政策的证据时提到了折扣。

col: discount the possibility｜不考虑这种可能性
tip: 名词重音在首音节；动词通常读/dɪsˈkaʊnt/。

senses.en: The spirit of a dead person, imagined as appearing alive.
A very slight trace of a feeling, expression, or quality.

ex.en: I copied a ghost story into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把鬼故事抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a ghost story.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕鬼故事展开说明。

col: a ghost of a smile｜一丝微笑
tip: a ghost of a smile指一丝若有若无的笑。

senses.en: To pay someone to do a job.
To pay to use something for a limited time.
An arrangement to use something temporarily in exchange for payment.

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to hire staff.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须雇用员工。

ex.en: When the class discussed economic policy, the speaker told us to hire staff.
ex.zh: 全班讨论经济政策时，讲者让我们雇用员工。

tip: 租车英式常用hire，美式常用rent。

senses.en: Without a paid job but available for work

ex.en: Office hours began with the long-term unemployed.
ex.zh: 答疑从长期失业者开始。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss the long-term unemployed.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论长期失业者的材料。

tip: the unemployed指失业者群体，谓语用复数。

senses.en: Hopeful, confident, or producing a good effect.
Completely certain that something is true.
Showing a condition is present, or mathematically greater than zero.

ex.en: Our professor circled positive attitude on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了积极的态度。

ex.en: The author returns to positive attitude when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了积极的态度。

col: positive result｜阳性结果；良好结果
tip: 检测结果positive指阳性，不一定是好消息。

senses.en: A person who plays drums, especially in a musical group.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a skilled drummer.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论技艺娴熟的鼓手。

ex.en: A campus survey used a skilled drummer to explain a pattern in the humanities.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用技艺娴熟的鼓手来解释人文学科中的一种模式。

col: a skilled drummer｜技艺娴熟的鼓手
tip: drum加-er构成drummer，注意双写m。

senses.en: to identify someone or something known from before
to accept or understand that something is true or important
to officially accept something or honour someone's achievements

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to recognise a face.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何认出一张脸。

ex.en: The reading asks you to recognise a face and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你认出一张脸，然后再核对第二个来源。

col: recognise the importance of｜认识到……的重要性
tip: recognise 常见于英式英语；美式多用 recognize。

senses.en: Physical harm to someone's body, often caused by an accident

ex.en: The textbook introduces a serious injury in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了重伤。

ex.en: The reading connects a serious injury with a larger point about public health.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把重伤和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 具体伤处可数；泛指身体伤害时常不可数。

senses.en: The outside or top layer of something
To rise to the top of water
To become known or noticeable after being hidden

ex.en: I copied a smooth surface into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把光滑的表面抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The reading connects a smooth surface with a larger point about the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把光滑的表面和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: on the surface 指“在表面上”，也可指“表面看来”。

senses.en: A particular form of something that exists in different forms
One person's account of an event

ex.en: Our professor circled the latest version on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了最新版本。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss the latest version.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论最新版本的材料。

col: a version of events｜对事件的一种说法
tip: version指同一事物的不同形式，也指个人对事件的说法。

senses.en: To become liquid through heat, or make something become liquid
To become gentler emotionally, or make someone feel this way

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to melt ice.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何使冰融化。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to melt ice.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来使冰融化。

col: melt someone's heart｜打动某人的心
tip: melt指受热融化；dissolve指溶于液体。

senses.en: Across many places or among many people
With a large difference between people, things, or situations

ex.en: The professor told us to widely available and then compare notes.
ex.zh: 教授让我们随处可得的，然后比较笔记。

ex.en: Students who widely available are less likely to misread the lecture.
ex.zh: 能够随处可得的的学生不太会误读这场讲座。

tip: widely指范围广；wide还可表示充分张开。

senses.en: a device that joins papers using small metal staples

ex.en: Our professor circled a desk stapler on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了桌面订书机。

ex.en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of a desk stapler.
ex.zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得桌面订书机这个例子。

col: refill a stapler｜给订书机装钉
tip: stapler是订书机，staple是订书钉，也可作动词。

senses.en: Used for immediate basic care after injury or sudden illness.

ex.en: The quiz expected us to recognize first-aid in a lecture clip.
ex.zh: 小测要求我们在一段讲座录音里认出急救的。

ex.en: Students who can explain first-aid usually follow the rest of a lecture on public health.
ex.zh: 能解释急救的的学生，通常跟得上一节关于公共卫生的讲座。

tip: 名词写作first aid；置于名词前可加连字符。

senses.en: A feeling of great happiness
A person or thing that brings great happiness

ex.en: I copied jump for joy into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把高兴得跳起来抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The reading connects jump for joy with a larger point about human behavior.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把高兴得跳起来和关于人类行为的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: jump for joy｜高兴得跳起来
the joys of parenthood｜为人父母的乐趣
tip: 表喜悦通常不可数；表乐事可数，如a joy。

senses.en: a person whose job is to protect people or places
to protect someone or something from danger or escape
a cover or barrier that prevents injury or damage

ex.en: The textbook introduces security guard in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了保安。

ex.en: A campus survey used security guard to explain a pattern in economic policy.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用保安来解释经济政策中的一种模式。

tip: guard against表示防范某种风险或错误。

senses.en: to draw a line beneath a word or phrase
to show that something is especially important

ex.en: The assignment is to underline a word, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先在单词下面画线，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to underline a word.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来在单词下面画线。

col: underline a word｜在单词下面画线
underline the importance of｜强调…的重要性
underline the need for｜凸显对…的需要
tip: 本义是在下方画线，也常用于强调重要性。

senses.en: A formal dance style, or a performance using this style.

ex.en: The textbook introduces classical ballet in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了古典芭蕾舞。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss classical ballet.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论古典芭蕾舞的材料。

tip: 词尾t不发音；英式重音在前，美式在后。

senses.en: sadness because something was not as good as expected
someone or something that fails to meet your hopes

ex.en: Office hours began with a bitter disappointment.
ex.zh: 答疑从极其令人失望的事开始。

ex.en: The reading connects a bitter disappointment with a larger point about human behavior.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把极其令人失望的事和关于人类行为的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: to my disappointment｜令我失望的是
a bitter disappointment｜极其令人失望的事
tip: 指情绪通常不可数；指令人失望的事可用a disappointment。

senses.en: a period of physical exercise to improve strength or fitness

ex.en: I copied daily workout into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把每日锻炼抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: In the lecture on public health, everyone remembered the example of daily workout.
ex.zh: 在关于公共卫生的讲座里，大家都记得每日锻炼这个例子。

tip: workout是名词；动词短语work out要分开写。

senses.en: A spiritual being believed to carry messages from God
Someone who is exceptionally kind or helpful

ex.en: Our professor circled guardian angel on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了守护天使。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around guardian angel.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕守护天使展开说明。

tip: 称某人为an angel，可表示对方善良或帮了大忙。

senses.en: The fact of no longer having someone or something.
Money lost when costs are higher than income.
A defeat in a game or competition.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about hearing loss.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于听力丧失的简答题。

ex.en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of hearing loss.
ex.zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得听力丧失这个例子。

col: at a loss｜亏本地；不知所措
tip: loss是名词，lose是动词，过去式和过去分词为lost。

senses.en: Growing crops or raising animals for food and other products

ex.en: I copied organic farming into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把有机农业抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The reading connects organic farming with a larger point about environmental policy.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把有机农业和关于环境政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 泛指农业时通常不可数；养殖也可用farming。

senses.en: Something valuable accomplished through effort or skill.
The successful completion of a goal through effort.

ex.en: I copied a major achievement into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把重大成就抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a major achievement.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕重大成就展开说明。

col: the achievement of goals｜目标的实现
tip: 具体成就可数；表示目标的实现时通常不可数。

senses.en: an arrangement for managing money or accessing a service
a spoken or written description of events
with for: explain something or constitute a share of something

ex.en: The textbook introduces account for in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了解释；占。

ex.en: A campus survey used account for to explain a pattern in economic policy.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用解释；占来解释经济政策中的一种模式。

tip: account for可表示“解释原因”或“占某比例”。

senses.en: not caring about others' feelings or treating them kindly

ex.en: I copied unkind remarks into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把刻薄的话抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss unkind remarks.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论刻薄的话的材料。

col: be unkind to someone｜对某人不友善
tip: 表示“对某人不友善”用be unkind to someone。

senses.en: the dividing line between countries or regions
a strip around the outside edge of something
to share a boundary with a place

ex.en: I copied a decorative border into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把装饰边抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The author returns to a decorative border when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了装饰边。

tip: border作动词直接接地点；border on还可表示近乎。

senses.en: good enough or suitable to be allowed or approved

ex.en: Our professor circled socially acceptable on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了社会认可的。

ex.en: The author returns to socially acceptable when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了社会认可的。

col: acceptable to everyone｜人人都能接受的
tip: acceptable表示达到要求，不等于优秀。
